# [reference] Brake rotor specifications and part numbers

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

[Partial] Raybestos brake rotors feature a minimum thickness of 26 mm and an Element3 runout tolerance of 0.004 or less. [t498]

## Parts

- Carquest YH145675P: Front rotor, painted [t498]
- Raybestos 980368FZN: Rear rotor, often mistaken for front [t498]
- Raybestos 980370: Front rotor, uncoated, rated Specialty - Truck [t498]
- Raybestos EHT Pads, Part # not specified: Brake pads often paired with these rotors [t498]

## Specifications

- **Brake pad thickness range**: 4 and 5 mm [t498] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Front rotor thickness (minimum)**: 26 mm [t498] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Minimum rotor thickness (general)**: 2 mm [t498] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Price difference (Uncoated vs Coated)**: 58% more [t498] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Raybestos Element3 runout tolerance**: 0.004 or less [t498] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Uncoated Raybestos front rotor runout**: 0.002 or less [t498] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
